SELECT series_id, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id IN ('LASST390000000000003', 'LASST260000000000003') AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which Texas cities are home to the most named inventors?
SELECT inventor_city_name, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_region_code = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the total public debt outstanding on September 30, 2024?
SELECT try_cast(tot_pub_debt_out_amt AS double) AS total_debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_to_penny WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30'
How many public schools offer virtual instruction, and how much of it?
SELECT virtual_text, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_129 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many private foundations filed a 990-PF return for tax year 2022?
SELECT count(DISTINCT ein) AS foundations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_990_index WHERE return_type = '990PF' AND substr(cast(tax_period AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2022'
Which compounds are named in the most patents?

SELECT t.c1 AS compound, count(DISTINCT p.c1) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent AS p JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = p.c0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the Democratic presidential vote in Westchester County change from 2016 to 2024?

SELECT year, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NEW YORK' AND county_name = 'WESTCHESTER' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND party_simplified = 'DEMOCRAT' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which law reporters carry the most cases in the archive?
SELECT reporter, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.citations WHERE reporter IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of adults in Los Angeles County have diabetes?

SELECT try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'DIABETES' AND datavaluetypeid = 'CrdPrv' AND locationname = 'Los Angeles' AND stateabbr = 'CA' AND year = '2022'
Which research concepts are tagged on the most works?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_concepts ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many robocall complaints did people in Florida file with the FCC in 2021?
SELECT count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'FL' AND issue LIKE '%Robocall%' AND date_created LIKE '%/2021'
Which incorporated cities and towns cover the most land?
SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_place WHERE funcstat = 'A' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How did New York City's unemployment rate change from April 2020 to December 2024?

SELECT year, period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUCT365100000000003' AND ((cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period = 'M04') OR (cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12')) ORDER BY year
Which states are home to the most companies filing financial statements with the SEC?
SELECT stprba, count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE countryba = 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audits disclose a material weakness in internal control?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_internal_control_material_weakness_disclosed AS varchar), 1, 1)) IN ('Y', 'T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_general
Which countries' patent documents are cited most often by U.S. patents?
SELECT citation_country, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_foreign_citation WHERE citation_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemistry patents were published by the World Intellectual Property Organization in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE country = 'WO' AND substr(cast(publication_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2015'
Which states have the most tax-exempt organisations?
SELECT state, count(*) AS organisations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patents has the USPTO withdrawn after granting them?
SELECT count(*) AS withdrawn FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE cast(withdrawn AS varchar) IN ('1', 'true', 'True')
Which countries host the most clinical trials?
SELECT country, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_locations WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What interest rate did 30-year conventional mortgages carry on average in 2023?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(interest_rate AS double)), 3) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(loan_type AS varchar) = '1' AND loan_term = '360'
Which research institutions have published the most works, according to OpenAlex?
SELECT display_name, country_code, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many different power plants have reported to the EIA's annual generator survey?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant
Which molecular formulas are shared by the most PubChem compounds?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much electricity came from hydroelectric dams in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.HYC-US-99.A' AND period = '2023'
What kinds of public school are there, and how common is each?
SELECT sch_type_text, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many professional, scientific and technical jobs were in Santa Clara County in 2021?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cns12 AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'ca' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2021 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '06085'
Which cities are home to the most federal political committees?
SELECT cmte_city, cmte_st, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
On average, how many days of extra patent term do patents get for USPTO delays?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double))) AS avg_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which companies operate the most natural gas pipeline segments?
SELECT replace(operator, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_natural_gas_pipelines WHERE replace(operator, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns involved Toyota vehicles in 2010?
SELECT count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE maketxt = 'TOYOTA' AND substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2010'
Among the most specific research concepts, which have the most works?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_concepts WHERE cast(level AS varchar) = '5' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the longest term extension any U.S. patent has received, in days?
SELECT max(try_cast(term_extension AS double)) AS days FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_term_of_grant
Which vendors were paid the most by federal campaigns in 2024?
SELECT name, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS paid FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many businesses registered in SAM.gov list a physical address in Montana?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'MT'
Which urban areas cover the most land?
SELECT name, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_ua GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average annual pay in securities and investment firms in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual WHERE area_fips = 'US000' AND agglvl_code = '15' AND own_code = '5' AND industry_code = '523' AND year = '2023'
Which drugs cost Medicare Part D the most nationwide in the latest year on file?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT brnd_name, round(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS drug_cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
